name: smwpatches-configurable-amount-of-baby-yoshi-eat-sprites
title: Configurable Amount of Baby Yoshi Eat Sprites
description:
This patch lets you set the number of sprites baby Yoshi must eat in order to become an adult Yoshi on a per-level basis. Just edit the values in "YoshiEatsTable.asm" and then patch "CustomYoshiEats.asm" with asar.

Note: Eating a powerup will still cause Baby Yoshi to instantly become adult.
